newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon gross reserves rise in mid-October.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon gross reserves rise in mid-October.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon's gross foreign exchange reserves rose $139.82 million in the second half of October to $5,411.7 billion, according to the central bank's bi-monthly balance sheet issued on Monday.
Gross reserves went up by $96.9 million in the first half of October to $5,271.9 billion.
The gross reserves include commercial bank's foreign exchange deposits with the central bank.
The balance sheet did not give the bank's net reserves but banking sources told Reuters they stood at $3.8 billion at the end of October from $3.640 in mid-October.
Net reserves were $2.858 billion at the end of 1995.
